command.name: Lure
verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to Taunt 3 Enemies in any lane for 2 round(s).
Odd-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +45%).

vanguard.name: Warrior's Resilience
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, reduce your Damage Received by -8%. Increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Dragon's Valor
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -6% and increase your Strength by +10.2% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Ensnare
habits.verbatim: Round 1: Reduce Instinct and Initiative by -18% (enhanced by Intelligence) of 2 Enemies within adjacency for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Tempting Distraction
habits.verbatim: When you afflict an Enemy with Taunt: Increase their Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) and Fire Damage Received by +6% for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Infernal Force
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase the Fire Damage Dealt of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) and the Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) by +14.4%. Each effect lasts for 3 rounds.

habits.name: Siren's Call
verbatim: Start of Round 1: Reduce your Physical Damage Received by -10% for 3 round(s).
Start of Rounds 1-3: 40% chance to Taunt all Enemies until the end of the round. Targets that are already afflicted with Taunt will be afflicted with Stagger instead.
